# Matrix

Matrix is a neon-green, cyberpunk theme with Live Preview parity and an always-on animated glow on H1 and the inline title. Links, blockquotes, code blocks, tables, tags, inputs, menus, tabs, Dataview and Mermaid are styled together, with terminal-style mono code blocks and hover glows. Style Settings adds an optional Digital Rain overlay.

![Matrix screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dubefab/Matrix/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Matrix"
    author: "dubefab"
    repo:   "dubefab/Matrix"
    slug:   "matrix"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/matrix"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/dubefab/Matrix"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dubefab/Matrix/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a neon-green, cyberpunk Matrix-inspired theme with Live Preview parity and always-on animated H1 and inline title glow. Give links, blockquotes, code blocks, tables, tags, inputs, menus, tabs, Dataview, and Mermaid cohesive styling with terminal-style mono code blocks and hover glows; add an optional Digital Rain overlay via Style Settings."
}
```
